name: Amamiya Tokiharu
source:
The protagonist's ex-boyfriend before she reinvented herself.
The way he treated her and eventually dumped her was one of the main reasons she decided to change.

He should have been going to a different University, but for some reason he going to the same school as the protagonist is currently going to.
